programs.title: Law & Order
programs.desc: The detectives sort through a murdered tenant's long-running battle with her landlord in order to find a possible suspect.

programs.title: On the Come Up
programs.desc: Sixteen-year-old Brianna Jackson is a gifted rapper who plans to take the battle rap scene by storm to lift her family and do right by the legacy of her father, a local hip-hop legend whose career was cut short by gang violence. However, when her first hit song goes viral for all the wrong reasons, she finds herself torn between the authenticity that got her this far and the false persona that the industry wants to impose on her.

programs.title: Love Island
programs.desc: Singles come together in a tropical location to look for romance, with one couple winning a cash prize.

programs.title: The Furies
programs.desc: Waterloo now has its own semi-pro men's hockey team, pushing the amateur women's leagues out of the arena. To avenge their lost ice time, an impulsive hockey player and a ruthless octogenarian-a former derby champion-have a plan: recruit the town's outcasts and create an underground roller derby team.

programs.title: The Roses
programs.desc: Life seems easy for picture-perfect couple Theo and Ivy: successful careers, a loving marriage, great kids. However, a tinderbox of fierce competition and hidden resentments soon emerge when Theo's career nosedives and Ivy's own ambitions take off.

programs.title: From the World of John Wick: Ballerina
programs.desc: Trained in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma, Eve Macarro takes on an army of killers as she seeks revenge against those responsible for the death of her father.

programs.title: Before I Change My Mind
programs.desc: In 1987, other students wonder if new kid Robin is a boy or a girl, as Robin forges a complicated bond with the school bully and makes increasingly dangerous choices to fit in.

programs.title: Kalinga (Care)
programs.desc: At the age of six, director Kent Donguines' mother leaves him and his family in the Philippines to become a nanny overseas. Now an adult, he shares the stories of several Filipina caregivers in Vancouver, bearing witness to their sacrifice as they struggle to reunite with their children. Kent maps out the emotional landscape and trauma of migrant labor.

programs.title: Freud's Last Session
programs.desc: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind.

programs.title: Ailey
programs.desc: Filmmaker Jamila Wignot examines the life of visionary dancer and choreographer Alvin Ailey.

programs.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem
programs.desc: After years of being sheltered from the human world, the Turtle brothers set out to win the hearts of New Yorkers and be accepted as normal teenagers. Their new friend, April O'Neil, helps them take on a mysterious crime syndicate, but they soon get in over their heads when an army of mutants is unleashed upon them.

programs.title: Gone Mom
programs.desc: Police investigate Fotis Dulos when his wife, Jennifer, mysteriously disappears after driving their five children to school.
